programme.desc: Europe remains the world's second smallest continent and is incredibly diverse.Temperatures there reach from +40 to -40 degrees.The three-part documentary will show its unique nature.

programme.title: America's National Parks
programme.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses A visit to the most spectacular places in the United States.It was in this country that the first official national park in the world - Yellowstone - was created in 1872.Documentarians combined spectacular photos with engaging narration and music, creating a story about magical places and their inhabitants.In subsequent episodes, they discover the secrets of, among others, Badlands National Park in South Dakota and volcanic Hawaii.The beginning of their expedition is the park, whose unique landscape attracts approximately six million tourists from all over the world every year.Rocks teeming with life Grand Canyon National Park was established in 1919.Characteristic layers in the rock formations provide insight into the history of the Earth dating back millions of years.California condors nest here.Each of them is marked and monitored by scientists who managed to recreate the disappearing population.Cameras follow the growth of one of the predatory chicks - from hatching to its first flight.Viewers will watch the hunting of a fawn puma and an Arizona heloderma.They meet the inhabitants of the forest-covered Kaibab Plateau.They will see why the monumental rocks of the canyon were a sacred place for Indian tribes.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu reserve, a female leopard gives birth to two cubs and will do everything in her power to protect them.Progressing climate change causes resources to shrink, which leads to growing conflicts over territory.The film, which is the result of three years of careful observations, reveals previously unseen fascinating behaviors of these mysterious predators.Thanks to unique recordings, viewers can take a closer look at the fight for leopards' survival in a changing world.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees: Season 1
programme.desc: National Geographic traveler and explorer, Bertie Gregory, takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of bees.For three years, the creators of the documentary conducted observations, using specialized cameras placed inside the hive to capture the life of these insects up close.The film reveals their complex architecture, social behavior and extraordinary intelligence of over 20,000 species of bees.They are responsible for pollinating one third of the food produced in the world and are considered one of the most important animals on our planet.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind: Season 1
One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken, among others, in the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.
